lines.en: label mall45:
scene mall1
I make my way to the mall because I’m in a generous mood and want to buy presents for Ayane and Maya since they’ve been through a lot lately.
Oh, who am I kidding? I’m here to hang out with Chika.
The “Sensei Love Squad” is nice and all, don’t get me wrong. Like, it’s an entire squad centered around loving me and things don’t really get any better than that.
But it’s also nice taking time off every now and then to remind myself that there are girls still mostly detached from the crazy happenings of the universe.
scene black
As I round the corner and head into Le French Store or whatever Chika’s business is called, that thought rings out in my head.
It bounces back and forth in the leftmost section of my brain until dissolving into nothingness and leaving me with the cranial aftertaste of complacency and nonchalance.
scene chikascarves1
But then it sours as I see Chika holding a familiar scarf — and those dissolved thoughts reform once more.
No one is detached from the crazy happenings of the universe.
But it would be nice if I was able to believe they were for more than just a few minutes at a time.
: Can I help you?
: Yeah. I’m looking for a girl around your age who might want to make out for a little while.
: Sorry. I have a boyfriend.
: I know. I am him.
scene chikascarves2
: Huh? You’re-
scene chikascarves3
: Ah! Hey! I wasn’t expecting you today.
: I could tell by the way you so quickly rejected me.
scene chikascarves4
: Yeah, sorry about that. There was another guy a couple hours ago who tried the same thing, so I like, half-expected you to just be him coming back.
: There was another guy who just...approached you and asked you to make out?
scene chikascarves5
: He actually only asked where the bathroom is. But I still told him I had a boyfriend and that made him go away.
: I wonder if he ever found the bathroom?
Well, at least I know she’s loyal.
: Kinda weird, though. We’ve had several guys come into the mall today. Thought for a second the war might have ended. Turns out there’s just some porn convention going on this weekend.
: And we’re not there...why?
scene chikascarves6
: Because I can’t legally get in.
: Oh. Yeah, that’ll do it.
: Are you that into porn, Sensei?
: That depends.
: On?
: If this is some sort of trap.
scene chikascarves7
: It’s not a trap. I’m not one of those girls who forbids her boyfriend from watching porn. I get that I can’t be there to assist you all the time.
scene chikascarves8
: So, in my moments of absence, feel free to jerk off to whatever or whoever you like without the fear of me getting jealous.
: But also know that if any of that ever leaks into reality and you wind up cheating on me...I will destroy everything you love. Not including myself, of course.
: I feel like that part didn’t need to be included, but thank you nonetheless. I will also allow you to look at porn if that makes me sound like a good and respectful significant other.
scene chikascarves9
: I’ll keep that in mind. Not like I have much time for that stuff anyway, though. Between work, Chinami, Yumi, and you...my time is pretty much all taken up.
: I would have liked going to that convention with you, though. Sounds fun.
: On that note, how’s Chinami doing?
scene chikascarves2
: Chinami? Fine. Why do you ask?
: Between the fever and her immune-thing-
: Fever? Chinami hasn’t had a fever in months. Where did you hear that?
: So...she’s totally fine?
: Probably even better than fine. Her and Tsukasa have been going crazy lately. Something about making the Fortune 500 or something?
Did the reset...somehow cure Chinami?
I know Maya alluded to physical stuff being reset sometimes as well, but I guess it didn’t occur to me that it could work like this.
That’s...kind of great, actually. There’s finally another benefit to this whole infinite time thing other than just giving me the ability to bone teenage girls for the rest of my life.
: Sensei?
: Oh, my bad. Must have been misremembering or something. I’m glad to hear she’s doing okay, though.
scene chikascarves8
: Heh...it’s cute you were worried about her. But yeah, she's fine.
: Great. So, back to the porn thing.
scene chikascarves10
: Are you really that desperate to not come across as sentimental? It’s fine if you sound a little caring every now and then, you know. I like that side of you.
: I wouldn’t be dating you if all I was into was the sex.
: To be fair, the sex is pretty great. I wouldn’t blame you.
scene chikascarves11
: It is pretty great, isn’t it? Maybe we should do porn? Couples videos are getting pretty big nowadays, aren’t they?
: How do you know that if you never have time to watch anything?
: I didn’t say never. I just said it was hard to find the time for that stuff. Which is true.
: Either way, we probably shouldn’t have any physical, recorded evidence of our sexual relationship.
: Not even for when we’re older and you want to relive the glory days of fucking my tight, teen pussy?
: Welp, congratulations. Now I’m turned on.
scene chikascarves12
: Just doing my job. I’m only half-serious about the porn thing, though.
: Like, yeah, it would be nice to look back on that kind of stuff one day. But at the same time, the idea of anyone else being able to see us online is pretty nerve-wracking.
: So if we ever did make any sort of videos, I’d probably want to keep them private.
scene chikascarves13
: It does hurt kissing all of that potential money goodbye, though. Between your huge dick and my body, we could probably rake it in.
: I know you’re desperate for cash on account of the whole poverty thing, but I didn’t think you’d gotten to “considering porn” territory just yet.
scene chikascarves14
: It’s not a real consideration — just a little thought that came to me today on account of the convention buzz.
scene chikascarves15
: I do have to do something, though. It dawned on me during Christmas that what I make now is fine for just getting by, but it doesn’t really let me save anything.
: I don’t want to have to rely on you to take care of me forever. I want to be able to, like...put money away for a house or something. Or at least a nicer apartment.
: Folding scarves is easy, laid-back work...but it’s not going to get me to that point.
: That said...that scarf looks a little familiar, doesn’t it?
scene chikascarves16
: I’m trying to have a melancholic talk about my future and you’re more focused on the scarf part? What the heck?
: Am I right, though?
scene chikascarves17
: Hmm...now that you mention it, it does look kind of like Maya’s. And the other one looks a lot like Ami’s.
: They have to be different, though. I mean, they’re obviously different since they already own theirs. But these ones here were like, just made for this brand’s new winter line.
: In fact, I’m not even supposed to be putting them out yet. But we needed display pieces over here and I figured it would be fine so long as they’re not priced.
They’re the same scarves.
Chika might have an eye for fashion, but I’ve seen them both up close far too often to mistake them at this point.
But, if they’re from a brand new clothing line...how would that even work, exactly?
Were the ones I bought here previously just...prototypes or something?
scene black
I do my best to think back on how that conversation went...
scene chikascarves18
: Looking for a gift now, Sir?
: These actually just came in this morning.
scene chikascarves19
: It was so strange as well. We never ordered anything like these.
: But it’s not like I was about to just let them go to waste so...voila.
: So you’re selling things you never even ordered? How do you know how they should be priced?
scene chikascarves20
: Oh, I have no idea. I just guessed.
: If you act now, I’ll let you have both for just 4,000 Yen. My regional manager is on the way here anyway so I was actually just about to take them down and hide them.
: So I’m basically the only chance you have of selling these?
: You are! And-
: I’ll give you 2,000 Yen.
scene chikascarves21
: ...That’s half of the asking price.
: There is no asking price. This isn't even an item you're supposed to carry.
: 2,000 Yen or I walk.
: Fine...
: I guess this is my fault for revealing my secrets to you in the first place...
: Helloooo? Sensei? Anyone home?
scene chikascarves2
: Was there ever another girl who worked here?
: Uhh...yeah. Tons. This is a high end fashion store in the mall.
: Why, though? Is there another girl who hit on you that I need to jump? I mean...talk to?
: I’m just pretty sure I bought these exact scarves from someone else here...
: Uhh, well...first off, never buy anything here from anyone but me.
: But second, that’s not possible. Like I said, these are brand new. So unless you got your hands on, like, rough cuts of them or something, there’s no way.
: Would something like that even be sold here?
: I doubt it. That stuff is normally saved for, like...models or the family of the designers and whatnot.
: Huh...
: Why are you so fixated on these scarves anyway? It’s not even winter yet.
: I don’t really-
scene amibreak4
scene happy4
scene chikascarves22
: ...know.
: Right?! Like, there are so many other places I’d be a better fit for. My talents are wasted on Les Vêtements.
scene chikascarves23
: Sorry, what were we talking about just now?
: Hm? Different places for me to work.
: You told me I had to get out of there like, five minutes ago. Is that not what you meant?
: I don’t really...know what I-
: Ohohoh...is that Sensei I spy?! And with a top-fiver, no less?! Io, get my journal! It’s time for a ranking update!
scene chikascarves24
: What’s our excuse?
: I’m just here to hang out with you.
scene chikascarves25
: They won’t think that’s weird?
: Probably not. You’re a top-fiver, so it should be fine.
: Top-fiver in what? What’s this ranking for?
: Uta has an unofficial ranking of how much I love all of you.
scene chikascarves26
: And I’m not number one?!
: It’s an unofficial ranking, Chika. No one knows about us but Yumi.
: I’m still mad either way!
: Heyo! What are you guys yelling about?
scene chikascarves27
: Oh, nothing! Hahahah! Sensei was just telling me the funniest joke! Weren’t you, Sensei?
scene chikascarves28
: Uhh...yes.
: Knock knock.
: Who’s there?
: Doctor.
: Doctor who?
scene chikascarves29
: Oh, I get it! Like that one British TV show with the phone-
: Doctor Patterson. I regret to inform you that the cancer has spread to your grandfather’s brain and...he isn’t going to make it.
: I'm sorry you have to find out like this. I know it's sudden.
scene chikascarves30
: Hahah...hah...funny, right?
: Normally, my traumas don’t catch up to me until nighttime. Good joke, Sensei. I’ve never had comedy change my entire schedule around before.
: Sooooo...ignoring everything that’s happened over the last twenty seconds, what are you guys doing here?
: I don’t know anymore. I just don’t know.

: You don’t have to pretend to be interested in us. It’s not like you’re obligated to greet every single familiar face you encounter out in the open. You’re just going to make people uncomfortable doing that.
scene chikascarves31
: What was that, Io?
Well, it seems that Io’s distaste for Chika is one thing the reset can not cure.
: I said-
: Hahah! She’s got jokes of her own too! You’d just never know with how quiet she is in school! Hahaha! Anyway, hi! Don’t kill us, please.
scene chikascarves32
: I wouldn’t kill you, Uta. I like- are you blushing right now?
: You’re really pretty and being touched by you sent special signals to my brain. I'm sorry.
scene chikascarves33
: God, you are so friggin’ adorable!
: Hah...Heaven...
: Who’s a good girl? Who’s a good girl?
: Uta-chan...is a good girl...
: I’m going to puke.
: If only your best friend wasn’t so unbearable! Maybe then you and me could hang out more?
scene chikascarves34
: Oh, please. As if Uta would ever stoop to-
: Shh...
: Let me have this...
: Pardon the interruption, but my partially-twisted mind has immediately come up with a way to make that happen and potentially solve your financial issues, Chika.
scene chikascarves36
: It has?! How?! What is it?! What do I have to do?!
: Sell your soul.
: I thought I already told you porn was a no-go.
: Which is why you settle for the next best thing — a maid cafe.
scene chikascarves37
: Mm!
: Thank you, Sensei! I’ve remembered my place in the world and am now back to normal!
: Me? Working at a maid cafe? Alongside Uta and Ami? Yeah, no way. They’ve got a totally different appeal than me. There’s no way that would work.
: Besides, wouldn’t that be like, objectifying me or whatever? Aren’t you against that?
: Not as against it as you might think, slut.
scene chikascarves38
: The fuck did you just-
: Ignore Io! She wasn’t being serious! And...I think you’d be great, Chika! You don’t need the same appeal as me and Ami! Gyaru maids are like, totally a thing!
: We don’t have anybody like you! And I’m sure you could make more than whatever you’re making here!
scene chikascarves39
: Well, how much are you making exactly?
: I’m going to ignore all of the nights where Sensei shows up as they greatly skew the average, but...on a good night, I can walk out of there with around...20,000 yen?
scene chikascarves40
: Maybe...closer to 25,000? We get a percentage of every table and it gets kinda crazy some nights.
: Plus you get to keep the dress. Which isn’t to say that I would benefit from that in any way. It just seems like a thing you’d want to own since you like clothes.
scene chikascarves41
: Do you think I should do it? That’s, like...way more than I make here.
: Yes. Adding the maid outfit and shrine maiden dresses to everyone’s wardrobe is my unspoken mission on this planet and I will not rest until it is complete.
: And it won’t be weird for you? Knowing that people would-
: Chika.
scene chikascarves42
: Oh, yeah! I mean...because you’re my teacher. And a high school girl working somewhere like that might...cause problems!
: But I guess if you’re okay with Uta and Ami doing it, there’s...nothing to worry about at all!
: Come by when you’re free and I can show you around. I normally work nights. But since I’m basically the head maid, I can pretty much do whatever I want.
scene chikascarves43
: Uta, you are like, seriously saving my life right now. If there’s ever anything I can do to make it up to you-
: You can scratch under my chin and call me a good girl again.
: Are you sure that’s-
: Yes.
: I will also volunteer to-
: Please.
: Anyone.
: I need this.
scene black
Io walks away as Chika and I take turns scratching Uta’s chin.
That wasn’t the point of all of this, though — just a nice bonus.
The point is that Chika’s life may soon be changing as well.
And, if I’m remembering correctly, Ami’s eventual appearance at the maid cafe was the first major divergence in the world according to Maya.
I doubt Chika, if she decided to follow up on this, will make that same sort of impact.
But it is nice realizing that soon, things might get a little easier for her.
And a lot hornier for both of us.
